name: Nisshin (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nisshin city emblem in white: an outlined sun-like device of rays enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Nisshin, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in May 1906.

features.role: Nisshin city emblem — an outlined sun-like device of rays enclosing a stylised character
